settings.question: Are there any current openings?
settings.answer: We are always interested in hearing from passionate individuals who share our love of luxury fashion. Please send your CV and a brief cover letter to careers@marais.com.au.

settings.question: What roles do you typically hire for?
settings.answer: We hire across retail, buying, styling, operations, and digital. Whether you are an experienced buyer or just starting your career in fashion, we welcome your enquiry.

settings.question: How do I apply?
settings.answer: Email your CV and a short introduction to careers@marais.com.au. We review every application and will be in touch if your background aligns with our current or upcoming needs.

settings.question: Do you offer internships or work experience?
settings.answer: Yes — we welcome applications for internships and work experience placements across our boutiques and head office. Please reach out via email to discuss availability.

settings.heading: Get in Touch
settings.response_promise: We respond to all career enquiries within 3 business days
